Annual Prediction Method
(How will be my next one year?) (SUN is the ruler of a year in our horoscope)
1) Write down the planet position as per the birth chart.
2) Write down aspects between planets and between planets <> houses & Fortuna. Focus on 0, 60, 90, 120, 180 deg aspects only. 0, 90, 180 = Malefic. 30, 60, 120 Benefic.
3) Draw a KP Chart close to your birthday of the current running year in your current living location (Not in the birth location.)
4) Ensure that the SUN is precisely the same deg.min.sec. as that of your birth chart.
5) Note down the lagna position in the year time chart. (2026). If it falls in 1, 2, 3, 10, 11  as per the birth chart = Fortunate.

6) Rotate the year (2026) lagna to the birth lagna position. (This will transpose the planet position to your birth chart lagna / houses position. You will see the planets in transit as per the original birth chart cuspal positions.)
7) Write down the planet position as per the year time chart (2025).

8) Write down aspects between planets and between planets <> houses & Fortuna of the birth chart. Ignore Sun aspect to houses, if any, because it will be exactly the same as the birth chart since we have rotated the lagna to the original birth chart lagna position.
Interpretation
1) Sun <Favorable> Moon aspect = Fortunate year
2) Sun <Unfavorable> Moon aspect = Struggle year
3) Planets in birth chart favorable = Planets in year (2026) chart favorable = Fortunate year
4) Planets in birth chart unfavorable = Planets in year (2025) chart unfavorable = Struggle
5) Specifically, identify planets that are conjoined, opposing, square, trine (0, 180, 90, 120)
Sun transits 1 degree = 1 day = 24 hours * 60 = 1440 min
1 deg.min = 24 min.
